botAbsent.description: Invite the bot to {{name}} to use it there. Once it has joined, come back and reload to see its settings.

botUnknown: We couldn't confirm that AutoMuteUs is in this server. If the bot hasn't joined, <invite>invite it</invite> and these settings will apply once it does.

channel.cantPost: The bot can't post in this channel.
channel.checking: Checking that the bot can post in this channel...
channel.help: In Discord, turn on Developer Mode under Settings, Advanced, then right-click the channel and choose Copy Channel ID.
channel.idPlaceholder: Channel ID, or empty for none
channel.label: Summary channel
channel.ok: #{{name}}: the bot can post match summaries here.
channel.pickHelp: Channels are listed as the bot sees them in this server; ones it can't post in are greyed out. Enter an ID to use a thread.
channel.unchecked: Couldn't check this channel right now. It will be verified when you save.

confirm.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
confirm.reload: Discard your unsaved changes and reload this server's settings?
confirm.switch: Discard your unsaved changes and switch servers?

delays.caption: Voice transition delays in seconds
delays.description: Seconds to wait before applying voice changes. Rows are the current phase; columns are the next phase.
delays.descriptionEditing: Seconds to wait before applying voice changes. Rows are the current phase; columns are the next phase. Whole seconds from {{min}} to {{max}}.
delays.heading: Transition delays
delays.notApplicable: Not applicable: the bot only delays changes between phases

error.forbidden: You no longer have access to this server, or Discord has not granted the required access.
error.notFound: Settings could not be found for this server.

marker.customDefault: Custom value; the bot default is {{value}}.
marker.premiumDetail: Premium-only setting. AutoMuteUs applies it only on servers with premium.

noSelection.description: Choose a server to see and change its configuration.
noSelection.heading: Select your server

noServers.description: Only servers where you are the owner or have the Administrator or Manage Server permission are shown here. If you were just given that role, refresh your server list.
noServers.heading: No servers you can manage

notice: Changes apply to the bot when you press Save changes. Servers that never saved settings start from the defaults. Values that differ from the bot's defaults are marked Custom, and edits you haven't saved yet are highlighted in amber; Premium marks settings the bot applies only on premium servers.

page.description: Your server's voice rules, timing, and preferences in one place.
page.heading: Server settings
page.metaDesc: View and change AutoMuteUs voice rules, delays, and settings for the Discord servers you manage.
page.title: Server settings - AutoMuteUs

premiumLocked: This server doesn't have AutoMuteUs premium, so settings marked Premium are shown but locked.

reset.confirm: Every setting in {{name}} goes back to the default, including the match summary channel and operator roles.
reset.confirmWithChanges: Every setting in {{name}} goes back to the default, including the match summary channel and operator roles. Your unsaved changes will be discarded too.
reset.description: Put every setting back to the bot's default. Stats are kept.
reset.done: Settings reset to the defaults. The bot uses them from the next game.
reset.title: Reset settings

retention.minutesLabel: Minutes before the summary is deleted

roles.description: Members with any of these roles can start, pause, end, link, and unlink games. With no roles listed, everyone can. Once a role is added, members without one of these roles can no longer control games. The server owner and members with the Administrator or Manage Server permission always can, and they are the only ones who can change these settings, here or with /settings.
roles.heading: Bot operators
roles.help: Role IDs are saved as typed and not checked against the server. In Discord, open Server Settings, Roles, then right-click a role and choose Copy Role ID (Developer Mode).
roles.label: Operator roles
roles.notInServer: Not a role in this server
roles.pickHelp: Roles are listed as the bot sees them in this server.
roles.unknown_other: Not roles in this server: {{ids}}. Remove them to save.

save.saved: Settings saved. The bot uses them from the next game.
save.unreachable: We couldn't reach AutoMuteUs to save. Check your connection and try again.

signedOut.description: Sign in with Discord to manage settings for the servers you own or administer.
signedOut.heading: Choose how your crew plays

unavailable.description: This server isn't one you own or administer. Choose another server above.

validation.channelID: must be a Discord channel ID (17 to 20 digits), or empty for none
validation.delay: must be a whole number of seconds from {{min}} to {{max}}
validation.language: must be one of the installed languages: {{codes}}
validation.retention: must be a whole number of minutes from 1 to {{max}}, 0 to delete immediately, or -1 to keep forever
validation.roleID: is not a Discord role ID
validation.roleList: must be a list of role IDs
validation.tooManyRoles_other: has {{count}} entries, at most {{max}} are allowed

voice.aboutDescription: Each row is a game phase. The columns show the configured microphone and hearing rules for alive and dead players. These are bot settings, not a live view of anyone's Discord audio state.
voice.caption: Configured voice rules by phase and player status
voice.customDefault: Custom value; the bot default is {{mute}} and {{deaf}}.
voice.description: Microphone icons show speaking rules; headphones show hearing rules. A slash means blocked. Hover or focus a label for details.
voice.descriptionEditing: Microphone icons show speaking rules; headphones show hearing rules. A slash means blocked. Select a pill to flip that rule.
voice.heading: Voice rules

muteSpectator.description: When enabled, spectators are muted like dead players. Servers with music bots often leave this disabled so spectators can continue hearing the music.
muteSpectator.label: Mute spectators

voice.premiumNote: Unmuting dead players during tasks and muting spectators can require many additional Discord voice requests. They are not recommended for non-premium servers, where requests may be slower or delayed.

unmuteDead.about: About unmute dead players during tasks
unmuteDead.description: When enabled, dead players can speak during tasks. This can reveal impostors to alive players if they are not prevented from hearing dead players.
unmuteDead.label: Unmute dead players during tasks

voice.unsafe: Potentially unsafe combination: dead players are unmuted during tasks while alive players are not deafened. Dead players may be able to tell alive players who the impostors are.
